agent_explanation: NS green starts at step ~525. S detector_fail goes active at 552 and stays active through 719. While it is active the actuated controller never ends NS green: it holds NS green continuously (~194s, far past max_green 90) despite growing EW demand, so E/W red waits grow monotonically (33 at 552, 132 at 650) until W hits 201 at 719 violating max_wait. Removing only the detector_fail restores cycling and removes the failure, implicating failed max-out/recall while a same-direction detector is failed.
